name: @ifhover/leaf-ui
description: A lightweight React component library with CSS variable theming.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-palette.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-locale.mjs --check && rslib build && node scripts/build-tailwind.mjs && node scripts/build-locales.mjs && node scripts/build-component-styles.mjs && node scripts/build-browser-entries.mjs
scripts.generate:locale: node scripts/generate-locale.mjs && biome format --write src/locales/zh-TW.json src/locales/schema.json src/locales/messages.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm check:release && pnpm build && pnpm check:package
